q: Ja Morant is out for weeks. Should I drop him, put him on IR, or ride it out? Do I have room to add another player, and who should it be?
short: Move Morant to your open IR spot instead of dropping him, which frees a roster spot. Then add Andrew Wiggins (free agent, instant), though the upgrade is small.
answer:
Put him on IR. Your data lists Morant as OUT, so he is IR eligible. Your 2 IR spots currently hold only Anthony Edwards, so one is open. Dropping him would throw away a player projected at 37.5 FP per game (31.2 over 4 games this season), well above the 32.0 replacement level, so there is no reason to cut him when IR is free.

Room: right now you have 15 active players plus Edwards on IR, so your 15 active spots are full and you cannot add anyone yet. Once Morant moves to IR you will have 14 active players and one open spot. Both IR spots will then be used, so any future injury will force a drop or a cut.

Timeline: I could not find any current reporting on how long he is out. Two searches only returned older injuries (a left elbow UCL sprain from January 2026 and some 2024 hip issues), nothing from this week. Treat the length of his absence as unknown and check Portland's official injury report. Because he is on IR, you lose nothing by waiting.

Who to add: the best healthy options are thin. Mikal Bridges projects 32.8 but is on waivers until Sun 2 AM, has 1 game, and a claim takes about 24 hours. Andrew Wiggins projects 32.0 (right at replacement level), is a free agent you can add instantly, and has 1 game this week. Kevin Porter Jr. (33.0) has no NBA team listed, so skip him. Jalen Williams (41.0) is a tempting stash but he is OUT and you would have no IR spot left for him. Your bench already has Sarr (36.6), Poeltl (31.7) and Pritchard (31.6), so this add is mostly depth. If you want the extra 0.8 FP per game, put in a Bridges claim, otherwise take Wiggins now.

moves.why: He is OUT, you have 1 of 2 IR spots open, and it drops your active roster from 15 to 14 while keeping his 37.5 FP per game projection.

moves.do: Add Andrew Wiggins as a free agent
moves.why: He is instant, projects 32.0 FP per game with 1 game this week, and fills the open spot at replacement level; Bridges (32.8) is a marginal upgrade but is on waivers until Sun 2 AM.
